title: Compact-support composition at field coefficients over qcqs finite-type schemes
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside it [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z$ be separated finite-type morphisms of quasi-separated finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For $\Lambda=E$ use the rationalized coefficient categories [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and for $\Lambda=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ use the common finite-stage categories [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. For the compact-support functors defined by integral derived limits and coefficient passage in [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], the canonical compactification composition comparison is a natural isomorphism
$$\alpha_{g,f}:Rg_!Rf_!\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }R(gf)_!:D^b_c(X,\Lambda)\longrightarrow D^b_c(Z,\Lambda).$$
Here the comparison is the field-coefficient passage of the proper/open compactification comparison: for compatible compactifications $Y\xhookrightarrow{i}\overline Y\xrightarrow{q}Z$ and $X\xhookrightarrow{a}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}\overline Y$, put $V=p^{-1}(Y)$, write $a=bc$ with $b:V\hookrightarrow\overline X$ open and $p_Y:V\to Y$ proper, and use the proper/open comparison $i_!Rp_{Y*}\simeq Rp_*b_!$, followed by $Rq_*$ and $c_!$. No separatedness of $X,Y,Z$ over $k$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0F7J, lemma-shriek-composition (compatible compactification comparison at finite coefficients); field-stage extension of this comparison using Bhatt–Scholze Definition 6.7.6 and Lemmas 6.7.7, 6.1.13, and the common-stage construction. This field-stage assertion is an additional obligation, not a claim that 0F7J treats non-torsion discrete coefficients.
